userMessage: I need to set up a Slack OAuth credential. Walk me through the Slack admin so I can find my Client ID and Client Secret to enter into n8n.
rationale: When Browser Use is disabled globally the orchestrator must not pretend any browser tool exists. It should explain the standard credential setup path instead. Pairs with the OAuth-positive scenarios to prove discovery is gated on Browser Use state, not blindly triggered by the user message.
